name: Muze
tagline: Hand it off. Go live your day.
description: Muze is a personal AI agent. No forms, no prompts to get right: Muze asks only what it needs to know, then gets started. Tasks run in the background for hours, or wait up to 14 days for an email reply; when the answer arrives, Muze picks the task back up and tells you what changed. Attach a recording, a PDF, or a link and ask for what you need. Muze works in its own isolated computer and puts the result in your Library. It has its own @muze.bot email address and asks for your approval before emailing anyone outside your allowed list. Start free with 200 daily credits.
